description: Test suite file for the TUI submit handler module using Vitest. Contains tests for command parsing, burst coalescing, and environment detection logic related to submitting commands in a terminal UI.

methods.name: createSubmitHarness
methods.description: Helper function to create test harness for submit handler tests.

methods.name: createSubmitBurstCoalescer
methods.description: Creates a coalescing function to combine rapid submit calls into a single multiline submission.

methods.name: shouldEnableWindowsGitBashPasteFallback
methods.description: Determines if the environment should fallback for Git Bash paste handling based on platform and environment variables.
